description: This file contains the implementation of the FormFactory class within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package. It provides static methods to load, retrieve, and construct form models from XML resources for the OFBiz framework, supporting caching, resource resolution, and different contexts such as classpath and web application.

classes.name: FormFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for loading and creating form models from XML resources, with support for caching and context-specific resource resolution within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getFormsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads all forms from the specified resource location, parsing the XML document and returning a map of form names to ModelForm objects.

methods.name: getFormFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific form by name from a resource location, utilizing cache if available, and constructing the ModelForm if necessary.

methods.name: getFormFromWebappContext
methods.description: Obtains a form from the web application's context and request, resolving resource URL, extracting the form element, and caching the result.

methods.name: readFormDocument
methods.description: Processes an XML document representing forms and converts each form element into a ModelForm object, supporting multiple forms within a document.

methods.name: createModelForm
methods.description: Creates a ModelForm instance (single or grid) based on the form element's attributes and structure.
